card.name: Endings of Turkish names and drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a rare multi-part proper name, often a Turkish place or person name (Suleymaniye, Osmaniye, Hüseyin) or a brand or drug name (SAVAYSA, -ine endings), where the word is being completed.

modes.label: Turkish and Ottoman names
modes.description: Final syllable such as -ye, -e or -use that completes a Turkish or Ottoman name.
modes.example: magnificent Suleymani<<ye>> Cami named for him

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: Last piece of a brand or generic drug name, such as SAVAYSA or an -ine ending.

card.plain: It fires on the last syllable of unusual names, mainly Turkish names and some drug brand names.
evidence: among them the magnificent Suleymani<<ye>> Cami named for him
